test_title: PYST 02: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 01 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Placing a huge magnet atop the temple __pose to being __the biggest hurdle for the masons.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**pose to being**".
 
• The correct form should be "**posed to be**" to maintain the past tense and grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the verb form used in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Placing a huge magnet atop the temple posed to be the biggest hurdle for the masons."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **No improvement required** – This would be the correct option if the sentence was already correct, but it isn't due to the incorrect verb form.
 
• **Posing as be** – This option is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Poses for being** – This option is also grammatically incorrect.
